name: SAEngine generic defaults
description: Generic defaults (SAEngine practice): single values a code pack does not give. They are not part of any code: each file's $notes says where a value comes from, and results and the report name them as generic defaults. A value is used only when the code pack in force has the table but not the value; a pack that gives the value always wins, and a project override wins over both. Not a code pack: never listed, chosen or extended.
